inputs.text: This isn’t just a constitutional dispute—it looks like a coordinated effort to make a power grab appear legitimate. The reported aim of keeping Emmerson Mnangagwa in office until 2030 tells you who stands to benefit. Job Sikhala’s call for rejection may draw attention, but the bigger play is rewriting the rules while the public is steered toward treating it as ordinary process. The question is what else this maneuver is meant to hide.
